finding.problem: Reversing the weights before calling reference_impl.allocate and reversing the result after flips the documented lowest-index tie-break to highest-index, so allocate('0.01',[1,1]) returns [0.00, 0.01] instead of main's [0.01, 0.00] (and the first invalid weight reported changes too).
